title: KAITO — Natural Juggler!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Humhumhumm♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Airi and the others helped me become a better juggler in such a short amount of time. I might actually be able to go a little faster now.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yo! Ho! Ha...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! Look how fast he's going!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: When did you become so good at this?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
After the girls taught me how.
Now that I've gotten the hang of things, I've been able to increase my juggling speed.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?
I couldn't do it even at a normal speed!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It looks very difficult.
I doubt I could manage it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hang on, Luka...
Have you not had a chance to do this yet?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, I spent all of my time playing the other New Year's games.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
In that case, you should give it a try.
It's both simple and very fun.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I might take you up on that.
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There! We! Go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa...! That's amazing!
You're so good at this, Luka!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You've really picked it up so fast!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for taking the time to teach me, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
And you were right.
This is so much fun that I don't feel like stopping.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm glad that you understand what I meant.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Can you teach me how to juggle too?!
I might finally be able to with you as my teacher!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course. I'll do my best to help.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
So, let's see...
Why don't we start by gently tossing the sacks into the air?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is to get you used to tossing and catching them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, I'll give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, are you watching?! Up you go!

rows.Speaker: KAITO & Luka
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You threw it very high into the air.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry! I threw it way too hard!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Lemme try that again! Up you go!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, that seems like a better height.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, uhh... I'm supposed to catch it using my right hand, transfer it to my other one and toss it back into the air... Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, it landed on your head.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You panicked a little there.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sob*
This is so hard.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Don't worry. You'll get the hang of it soon enough.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Try to be consistent about how high to toss them. Once you've found that butter zone, you should be able to juggle like a pro at a steady pace.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: O-Okay! I'll keep trying!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There! We! Go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Did you guys see that?! I think I've got the hang of it now!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that was excellent.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That was incredible, Rin. You've improved so much.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks! I couldn't have done this without you, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You really are a wonderful teacher.
I also got the hang of this very quickly thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You're giving me far too much credit.
You two are able to juggle now because you put in the effort.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, I'm gonna make another attempt! You guys keep watching! I'll try going a little faster this time!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. We're watching. Keep doing your best.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Hehe. Rin seems so happy.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But that makes sense considering how much she practiced...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It really is nice to see the moment a person's hard work pays off.)
